name: Level Tower
tagline: 1 like = 1 floor. You pick the world.

episodes.title: One like. One floor.
episodes.summary: Floor 1 is a quiet grassland. Every like adds a floor, and your comments pick the world.

episodes.title: You pick the world
episodes.summary: Lava, ice and neon city stack up fast. The tower passes 180 floors.

episodes.title: Above the clouds
episodes.summary: 338 floors and every one of them named. 14 worlds are already waiting in the queue for the next likes.
